name: Professional licenses, certifications and memberships
one_line: The organizational situation of holding a durable professional standing that a body granted and that expires: licence and certification certificates, renewal notices, membership confirmations and good-standing letters, where the file is about the credential itself rather than about a job, a course, or a degree, and where a validity window - issued on, valid through, renewal due - is the structure that makes it recognizable.
design_cite: Extends 00's named Career launch domain to one organizational situation, in 00's own template vocabulary: 'Each template should define the domain’s allowed fact fields, detection signals, recommended folder dimensions, preferred dimension order, optional branch patterns, privacy rules, and validation constraints.' The material is named by 00 twice in privacy contexts - the corpus 'can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records', and the residual home names it too: 'Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials'. 00 nowhere separates licences from recruiting as its own template, so this row is inference, not design.
node_test: PASSES on two of the three licences, and explicitly not on the third. (1) Detection signals differ from the career schema's default recruiting situation: recruiting is evidenced by an employer plus a role plus process language (offer, interview, application); this row is evidenced by an issuing authority plus a credential title plus a labelled validity window, and a credential document names no role and belongs to no process. (2) Privacy rules differ: 00 names 'credentials' inside both its sensitive-corpus sentence and its Protected Records definition, so a credential-number-bearing document routes toward Protected Records where a job description does not - that difference is the point of the row. (3) The recommended dimensions do NOT differ and could not: the career schema declares no field rows (D1 as narrowed, CONNECTION PR-6), so every career template's dimension_order is empty by contract and no template on this schema can be licensed by its dimensions today. The recommendation is recorded as prose in template.why so R1c/P10 can restore it the moment the career field rows are decided.
fields_note: Empty by contract, not by omission, and not because a template may leave fields empty. Templates reference their schema's fields (CONNECTION section 3: 'Templates reference a schema; they never copy its fields'), and the career schema declares none: S3/D1 as narrowed defer the career field keys, owed before P10, and _CONTRACT rule 15 permits a placeholder schema to carry an empty field list. So activating this template's schema legitimises the universal facts only, and every file example below records facts_legal accordingly.

proposed_fields.why: RECORDED, NOT WRITTEN. This is a proposal for the moment S3/D1's deferral lifts; it writes no field row here and reverses nothing. The concept is the load-bearing fact of this situation - a credential is a standing with an end date, which is what separates it from a completion certificate, a diploma and a transcript, and it is the discriminator three neighbouring templates already named in their collision signals toward this row. No canonical key covers it: creation_date is the filesystem/document timestamp of this file version, term is an academic term from dedicated term patterns, tax_year is a finance year, and application_cycle is an admissions cycle. reliability_ceiling direct because the value comes from a labelled Expiration / Valid Through slot, which is one of 00's reliable and explicit sources ('a labeled form field'); an unlabelled date-shaped token supports nothing (see never_alone). destination_eligible false deliberately: a folder level per expiry date would scatter one credential's own lifecycle across dates, which is the failure 00 warns against when it says putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders. It is a search, review and lifecycle field - the shape 00's residual lifecycle sentence already uses when it offers to 'surface travel confirmations after their date has passed'.

proposed_fields_note: Only one is proposed, and deliberately only one. The other three concepts this situation would want - the issuing authority, the credential itself, and the document type - are exactly what career.json's open question is about (whether the career row reuses institution / client / application_cycle or mints keys). Duplicating that question here, or answering it, would be this node closing a decision that is not its own; so this row proposes only the concept no existing key can hold and no other row has claimed.

deterministic: a credential title in a high-weight zone (filename, document title, page-one heading) together with a labelled identifier slot read from a table cell or form field whose label is a licence, registration, certification or member number. 00 makes the labelled slot readable and reliable at once: 'Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs', and a labelled form field is one of the design's reliable and explicit sources. Neither half is sufficient alone

a validity window: a labelled issue or effective-date slot together with a labelled expiration, valid-through or renewal-due slot on the same document. This pair is the structural signature of this template and the discriminator every neighbouring collision names - a completion certificate, a diploma and a transcript state that something happened, while a licence states that a standing currently holds and will end

an issuing-body gazetteer hit matched at a word boundary standing in the issuer position (letterhead, seal caption, footer registry line) - a regulatory board, licensing authority, certifying body or professional association - together with a credential term in the same zone. 00 requires the matching discipline outright: 'It should use word-boundary matching rather than substring matching', and the positional half too: 'It should use positional weighting because a value in a filename or document title carries more meaning than the same value in a footer or a late body-page reference'. R4 owns the gazetteer's contents; this row writes no list

a verification affordance in a labelled slot - a registry lookup code, a verification id or a verify URL - beside a holder name and a credential title. 00's PDF extraction preserves exactly these strings: 'URLs, email addresses, DOI values, citations, identifiers, and other structured strings that may later support file facts'

an email whose labelled subject slot carries a renewal or expiration term together with a labelled sender slot resolving to a licensing board or professional association, and a credential identifier in the body. 00's email extraction yields 'sender, recipients, subject, sent date' as structured slots; the source_type alone proves nothing (see never_alone)

a spreadsheet whose column headers read as a credential ledger - credential, number, issued, expires, renewed - which 00's spreadsheet extraction surfaces directly: it should yield 'sheet names, column headers, visible cell values, table-like regions, formulas only when useful, and dates or identifiers from labeled cells'

an archive manifest listing credential-shaped members beside no coursework and no recruiting members, read without unpacking. 00's manifest-as-evidence shape is its own: a ZIP 'may contain a transcript, personal statement, resume, certificate, and form, which is meaningful evidence of a purpose-defined application packet even when the outer archive name is vague' - here the manifest makes the credential reading plausible without making any member's facts
needs_llm: a decoratively laid-out certificate whose issuer, credential and dates all sit in free text or OCR with no labelled slot - the case rules cannot resolve safely, and 00 names this class of file among the reasons the hybrid engine exists ('unusual professional artifacts')

deciding whether the organization named on a certificate is the issuing authority or the holder's employer, on an employer-run internal certification. The model must cite the text that makes it the issuer and must return unknown otherwise; an employer name read as an issuer is the finance and employment-records seam below

an OCR'd portal capture: judging that it is a licence-status or registry page rather than a generic account page. 00's worked parallel is admissions - a screenshot reading 'Your Columbia University application has been submitted' - and the model is explicitly allowed to determine that an OCR'd screenshot is 'an application portal rather than a generic image'; a licensure registry is the same shape with a board in place of a school

whether a set of certificates, renewal notices and dues receipts is purpose-coherent as one credential's lifecycle rather than several unrelated records - a group-coherence question, and 00 lists 'one course, project, application, recruiting process, photo event, or submission packet' among the single organizing reasons a group may have
a credential whose vocabulary the deterministic pattern catalogue does not cover, including a non-English licence or a trade credential whose renewal language has no labelled slot

a training certificate that is also a study-compliance record, where the credential reading and the research reading are both supported. 00's rule decides the outcome rather than the model's preference: 'conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification'
never_alone: an expiration-date-shaped token alone. This is this row's own tempting false file: an insurance certificate, a passport scan, a subscription notice, a coupon and a warranty all carry an expiry, and this template's whole signature is a validity window - so the window counts only beside a credential title and an issuer in the same document. Fixture: Certificate of Liability Insurance - 2026.pdf, which carries an expiry and an issuing organization and is still the finance neighbour's record

the word Certificate, or a certificate-shaped layout, alone. Three neighbouring templates already name this as the shared evidence item in their collision signals - a course-completion certificate, a diploma and a licence are one document shape - and the layout discriminates none of them

an organization, board or university name alone. 00: 'Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization' - the same ambiguity that forbids it as group proof forbids it as sole activation proof

a bare 4-digit number read as a renewal year, and a bare digit string read as a licence number. 00's narrow-date rule names the trap: filenames contain 'numbers that look like years but are course identifiers, version numbers, build numbers, ZIP codes, or other unrelated values', and the design requires that 'Date candidates should be identified with explicit regular expressions and then parsed without fuzzy matching'

a source_type of email, archive, image, spreadsheet or calendar alone - file_kind_plausible is constitutionally never-alone, and 00 asks the engine to 'treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning'
the absence of EXIF on an image of a credential, read as proof it is a screenshot of a portal. 00: 'the system must not mistake the absence of EXIF for proof that an image is a screenshot'

a holder name alone, and any producer or author metadata naming a body. 00 keeps authorship out of placement: 'It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension', and warns that 'a value such as python-docx' is a tool, not a person
membership in a download session that happened to bundle several certificate PDFs. 00: 'A session should never be treated as proof of topic'

a credit-hour or contact-hour token alone. That is the continuing-education neighbour's evidence for a course of study; on this side it appears only as compliance evidence attached to a credential that is named separately

proposed_context_terms_note: PROPOSED, and marked so deliberately. 00 writes a literal context-term list for exactly one pattern family - 'a course-code pattern together with academic context' - and this row copies that SHAPE, not that list. R6 owns the term patterns and R4 the gazetteers; nothing here is a regex, a list contents claim, or a score.
work_types_note: These are VALUES, never roster nodes - 00: 'The system may create new values when it sees a new course, project, company, university, or event, but it should not invent new fields automatically'. They are recorded for the document-type-shaped career field that does not exist yet: the canonical work_type key is the academic schema's, and the career schema declares nothing, so today no career field can hold any of these. R1a must not read this list as a request for a node per credential kind.
grouping_reasons: one credential across its lifecycle: the original certificate, the renewal notice, the renewed certificate, the wallet card and the compliance record for the same licence number. This is the group this situation exists to make, and it is a P9 membership record, never a fact copied onto the sparse members - 00: 'The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files'
one issuing authority across several credentials the same person holds
a credential and the continuing-education evidence submitted to keep it, which is a group whose members sit on two different templates and keep their own facts on both sides

a credential copy that also sits inside a recruiting or application packet, held as multi-membership rather than as a move: 00 states the shape twice - 'a resume may support multiple recruiting processes' and 'A file may validly belong to more than one accepted group'

template.why: EMPTY BY CONTRACT, not by refusal, and the emptiness is the career schema's rather than this situation's: a dimension may only branch on a field its schema declares, and the career schema declares none (D1 as narrowed; _CONTRACT rule 15; CONNECTION PR-6, which holds the career dimension recommendation as prose until the schema lands). The recommendation is therefore recorded here in prose so R1c/P10 can restore it whole. Recommended, once the career field rows exist: the ISSUING AUTHORITY first, then the CREDENTIAL, then the DOCUMENT TYPE. The issuing authority leads for 00's stated parent-context reason - 'A work type such as Homework 3 is meaningful only after the course is known' - because a folder named Renewal Notice is unintelligible until it is known which body granted which standing, while Board of Nursing / RN Licence / Renewal Notice is complete. The credential sits between them because one authority commonly grants several, and because the credential is the thing whose lifecycle the group is built around. Two dimensions are deliberately NOT recommended. The expiry date is not a level: it is single-valued per document and would scatter one credential's own lifecycle across date folders, the scattering 00 warns about when it says 'For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders'. The holder is not a level, by 00's rule that 'It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension'. For the ordinary holder of one or two credentials this template should flatten rather than branch, which 00 asks for directly: 'It should recommend flattening when a dimension does not materially improve retrieval', and it warns against a level that would 'create meaningless one-child levels'. All of this is a recommendation and never a filesystem - 'The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions'.

privacy_rules: A credential-number-bearing document is offered the Protected Records residual before the Independent Records one, because 00 names this material inside that residual's own definition: 'Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials'. The home has to behave once chosen: it 'should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts'.

A single credential may be surfaced alone rather than waiting for a group, on 00's own licence for the sensitive-and-isolated case: 'Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold'.

Where a credential document carries a date of birth, a national identifier or a home address in a labelled slot, the identity safety schema is a separate activation on that file's own evidence, and 00's protection order applies before any model path: 'A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately' and 'Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default'.
This row assigns no handling class. The five classes are P7's vocabulary (_CONTRACT rule 5) and sensitivity here is 00's phrase only.

The lifecycle a renewal notice invites is review, never expiry-driven cleanup: 00 forbids the destructive reading outright - the system 'must not delete files, mark them disposable, or move them out of a protected area without explicit user action'.

collides_with.signal: both sides are evidenced by a certificate-shaped PDF naming a person and a professional body, and by a document a board issued about a licence holder. The discriminating evidence: that side needs a named course of study with a credit-unit statement for that course; this side names the licence, registration or membership itself with an issue or expiry date and no course of study. Reciprocates the edge academic.continuing-education already states toward this row, in its own words. Fixtures: CE credits transcript 2025 - Board of Nursing.pdf routes to that side; Your CPA license renewal is due.eml routes to this one.

a certificate naming a person, an issuing organization, a credential title and a validation number is one document shape and one evidence item on both sides. The discriminating evidence: that side needs an educational institution conferring academic credit or a degree, evidenced by a schools-gazetteer hit in the issuer position beside credit or degree language; this side is issued by a professional or regulatory body, names a licence or certification and typically an expiry, and confers no academic credit. Reciprocates the edge academic.transcripts-credentials already states toward this row. Shared fixtures: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Certificate.pdf and credentials.zip.

a platform completion certificate and a professional licence are the same document shape, and a holder name beside a credential identifier is one evidence item supporting either. The discriminating evidence: this side carries an expiry or renewal date, an issuing authority with a registry, and a number that verifies against that registry; a course completion carries a provider, a course title and a completion verification id with no expiry. Reciprocates the edge academic.online-course already states toward this row.

a board results letter and a licence certificate are both issued by a professional body about one person. The discriminating evidence: that side needs a sitting - a test name with a scaled score, an administration or a registration record; this side names the licence, registration or membership itself with an issue or expiry date and no sitting. Reciprocates the edge academic.standardized-testing already states toward this row, including its abstention case: a results letter that also confers the licence carries both halves in one document, and 00 requires that 'conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification'.

applying for a licence and applying to a professional school produce the same artifacts - a form, a fee receipt, a character-and-fitness questionnaire, an official-record request. The discriminating evidence is what is being applied for: a place to study, with an entry term and a programme, versus a licence, registration or credential, with an authority and a licence number. Reciprocates the edge applications.graduate-professional already states toward this row.

a human-subjects or lab-safety training certificate is simultaneously a professional credential and a study-compliance document: one completion record, one learner name, one issuing body. The discriminating evidence is whether a protocol-id-shaped token or a study title appears on or beside it; absent that, the credential side is the better-supported one, because the certificate is about a person and that template is about a study. Reciprocates the edge research.ethics-compliance already states toward this row. Fixture: CITI_Human_Subjects_Certificate_JYung.pdf.

a certificate issued by an organization carrying a labelled effective date and a labelled expiration date is one evidence item on both sides, and professional liability cover sits closest to the seam because the insured is named with a professional designation. The discriminating evidence: a policy number with coverage limits and an insurer in the issuer position is the finance record; a licence, registration or certification title with a registry-verifiable number and a granting authority is this side. Neither side may take the expiry alone, which is this row's own never_alone rule. Fixture: Certificate of Liability Insurance - 2026.pdf.

a renewal fee receipt and a membership dues invoice name the same body, the same person and often the same credential number as the confirmation document itself. The discriminating evidence: an amount with a payment instrument, an invoice or transaction identifier and no statement of standing is the transactional record; a statement that a standing holds, with a validity window, is this side. One evidence item - the body's name - must never count for both. Fixture: the dues line inside AMA Membership Confirmation 2026.pdf, which states a payment without being a receipt.

an employer's personnel file routinely contains the employee's licence, and an employer-run internal certification is issued by the employer itself - so an organization name beside a credential title is one evidence item on both sides of the same schema. The discriminating evidence: employment-record structure about the relationship (employer letterhead addressing the employee, a personnel or onboarding form, a role title) is that side; a granting authority with a registry-verifiable credential and a validity window is this side. The needs_llm entry above exists for exactly this pair.

the word credential, and a labelled identifier slot beside a person's name, support both rows - and the filename credentials.zip is a live fixture on this seam. The discriminating evidence: an authentication secret, key or account login is that safety row's material, which 00 places under immediate protection ('A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately'); a professional standing granted by a body, publicly verifiable against a registry, is this side. A shared word is not evidence, and neither row may take the other's document because both are called a credential.

also_holds_with_note: Empty by contract, not by judgement. also_holds_with joins SCHEMAS only (CONNECTION section 5), and this row is a template; the co-activation cases this situation genuinely produces - a training certificate that is a research artifact, a licence scan that is also identity material, an employment agreement that is also legal material - are already carried on the career schema row (career.json lists college_applications, academic and legal) or belong to the research and identity schema rows. Authoring them here would be inventing a template-to-schema edge the vocabulary does not contain.

falls_through_to.why: 00 names this material inside the residual's own definition - 'Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials' - and requires the home to behave: it 'should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts'. Offered before Independent Records for a document whose credential number, date of birth or national identifier is readable. Fixture: RN_License_California_2026.pdf with no accepted group.

00's description of this residual is this situation's leftovers almost word for word: 'standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group'. Fixtures: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Certificate.pdf, AMA Membership Confirmation 2026.pdf, Credential renewal tracker.xlsx, and Certificate of Liability Insurance - 2026.pdf once it is routed away from this template.

00 defines it for 'isolated invoices, delivery confirmations, booking records, boarding passes, purchase receipts, event tickets, and similar transactional documents' - a renewal fee receipt or a dues invoice is a transaction about a credential, not the credential. This is the residual half of the finance.receipts-expenses collision.

00: 'files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision' - the shape where a credential term resolved and the issuing authority did not. Fixtures: license.pdf, CITI_Human_Subjects_Certificate_JYung.pdf while the credential and study readings are both live, and CE credits transcript 2025 - Board of Nursing.pdf once it is routed away from this template.

a registry or portal capture whose OCR yields no issuer and no credential has 'no accepted project, trip, application, or event relationship'. Fixture: Screenshot 2026-05-02 at 14.03.11.png when its OCR is unusable.
a photographed wallet card with camera EXIF and no readable text has 'no event, project, reference collection, or photo-family association'. Fixture: IMG_5512.HEIC before OCR resolves anything.

00 keeps a home for 'password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats' and requires the rule that produces them: 'Password-protected, malformed, nested, or oversized archives should be marked as unreadable or partially inspected rather than forced open'. 00's safer option applies to this one - represent it without moving it. Fixture: credentials.zip while its locked member stays locked.

role_split_note: The role split this situation would want is real and unwritable today: the ISSUING AUTHORITY that granted a credential and the EMPLOYER that required it are the same entity type in different roles, which is 00's own pattern - 'distinct facets, such as authored_by and target_school, or our_firm and client'. role_split lives in the canonical field list between two field keys (CONNECTION section 6), and the career schema declares no keys, so there is nothing to split yet. Recorded here so the pair is not lost when the career field rows land; this row writes nothing into canonical_fields.json.
sensitivity_why: 00 names this material directly, twice. The corpus 'can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records', and the Protected Records residual is defined over 'passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials'. A licence document also carries a registry-verifiable identifier tied to a named person, and disciplinary or status notices carry more than that. Only 00's phrase is asserted here; the handling class is P7's and is not set.
open_question: Whether the credential lifecycle should be offered as an optional branch pattern on this template - one folder per credential holding its certificate, renewals and compliance records, versus a flat set of credential documents with the lifecycle expressed only as a P9 group. 00 licenses optional branch patterns as part of what a template defines, and its worked example of one is the purpose-defined packet held beside institution-first organization, so the fork is real and is a decision about someone's real filing habits rather than a fact about files. It cannot be settled here in any case: both readings need career field rows that S3/D1 defer, and the reuse-versus-mint question for the career keys themselves is career.json's recorded open question, not this row's to answer.
